rca_of_the_issue: Original RCA confirmed: regular Sincronizar Status only checks the local cobrança's stored asaas_payment_id, so it cannot detect when the customer paid another equivalent Asaas payment. The new reconciliation endpoint queries paid Asaas payments for the customer and matches pending local cobranças by payment id or by same value plus due-date window, persisting RECEIVED/reconciliada_por for the mismatch case.
